points.label: What follows
points.left: God’s promise and oath to Abraham lead to hope as an anchor, Jesus as forerunner, and a high priest forever after Melchizedek’s order.
points.right: Hebrews contrasts priests made without an oath with Jesus’ sworn and permanent priesthood, then speaks of covenant, intercession, and one offering.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: An oath establishes a lasting priesthood and a better covenant guarantee

payload.tension: The two sections use oath language for connected but distinct parts of the argument.
